headline: High outlook for long outages in Smith County
summary: Homes in Smith County lose power for 12 hours or more about once every 4 years. That comes from 8 years of records since 2018. The largest outage here began on June 2, 2024. At its peak, 56% of homes in the county were dark. For a home with electric heat, one Core lasts about 15 hours in January and about 31 hours in November. We suggest two Cores. That would have covered 79% of past long outage hours. Base confirms sizing at install.
